name: PAH3 s20 Map 5
description:
Submods required for map 5 of season 20 of the tournament and starting saves, more info in the pinned messages on this channel: https://discord.com/channels/298106089885401090/1096866734142656522 on the vcmi Discord server: https://discord.gg/chBT42V and in Polish in this thread in the Behemoth's Lair: http://imperium.heroes.net.pl/temat/5479
On 200% AI starts with as much resources as a human on 80%. On 130% AI starts with 15k gold like human, instead of 10k.
Most of randomness removed:
Random Creature and Hero abilities will always trigger.
Faerie Dragons always cast Meteor Shower, Enchanters always Haste, Genies always cast Frenzy.
Azure Dragons lower enemy Morale by 4 instead of causing Fear. Fearless ability changed into always at least 0 morale.
Luck and Molale always trigger.
Catapult always hits once. Always hits Wall first without Ballistics, always hits Wall and Towers at Basic, then also Keep on Advanced, then also Gate at Expert.
Creatures always do average damage, rounded up to 2 in case od 1-2, otherwise rounded down. Ballista always does 3 damage per attack point instead of 2-3.
Summon and Scullte Boat never work without Water Magic, always work with Water Magic, Magic Mirror always works and on Expert is a mass spell.
Quicksand and Land Mine are level 5 but fill the entire battlefield.
Earthquake destroys all walls.
All heroes get +1 Spellpower at level-ups.
Deleted heroes start with 0 movement thanks to an extra slow Peasant in their armies.
Heroes start with max armies (max troop counts like in pvp-balance mod).
Lumiere's Arquebusiers cast only Quicksand. Camera Obscura basically always casts Age, except on hero Midigriva, when it basically always casts Summon Apparition.
Resistance and resistance heroes banned (including Hanester from Courtyard). Other heroes unbanned.
Scholar with Resistance now gives Necromancy (changed that 1 Scholar on the map). Sir Mullich given to the enemy. Starting army of Elves replaced with Crossbowmen.
